requiredBeforeExecution: Verified Time Travel bookmark and timestamp
Encrypted restricted offline export with checksum
Current schema fingerprint and all old table counts/digests
Restore rehearsal and explicit restore authority
backupPlan.restorePolicy: Future separately authorized restore only; never down-migrate. Rehearsal never exported production data.
backupPlan.passCondition: Before execution, record verified current Time Travel bookmark plus backup checksum, prove restore access, and capture old table digests privately. Restore command is a future recovery plan, not authorized now.

maintenancePlan.required: Block every production D1 writer including account/auth, Commerce webhooks, report/generation APIs and schedulers; checkout/provider flags alone are insufficient.
sequence: Acquire enforced maintenance/write exclusion; freeze other production deploys
Reconfirm exact 0002 schema and existing row counts/digests
Sequentially apply 0003–0018 via Wrangler; stop on first failure
Verify read-only health; only then separately resume G3
maintenancePlan.enforcement: Must be implemented/verified before production authorization; not implemented under rehearsal.
maintenancePlan.passCondition: Before future execution, demonstrate all D1 write entry points are blocked, including GET handlers, verified webhook routes, active/old deployment URLs and scheduled/internal consumers; obtain explicit maintenance mutation authorization. Absence of traffic is not evidence.

rollbackPlan.mechanism: Verified D1 Time Travel restore / restricted backup restore, previous application deployment if required

historyBehavior.d1_migrations: Wrangler detects 0001/0002 by filename; records each 0003–0018 in migration execution SQL after successful SQL.
historyBehavior.runtime_migration_history: Custom repository runner-owned; remains empty under Wrangler. Never manually populate. Do not use custom runner against empty history to infer production pending sequence.

preExecutionGuards: Explicit new Human migration execution authorization
Exact accepted commit and frozen registry/files
Pending filenames exactly 0003–0018, no other files
Live schema still matches 0002 and counts/digests stable
Proven exclusion of every production D1 writer
postExecutionGuards: Wrangler history records 0001–0018 once; custom runtime history unchanged
All original row counts/PK/content digests unchanged
